items.title: Tommy Newsom and Ross Tompkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Or Roy Eldridge. Remember I was playing you that tape the other night? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Of course old timers always say that.

ctx.x: Well he has a way of playing. I don’t think a machine could ever do that.
Oh, no, you know who that is, there’s no doubt about that. It can’t be done electrically. Or Roy Eldridge. Remember I was playing you that tape the other night? You can’t duplicate that.
Of course old timers always say that.
